liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): Jerry's voice is highlighted for its quality, and the sound clarity is praised; Jerry's vocals are cited as some of his best, making this Wharf Rat performance huge [12][13]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Jack Straw is described as exceptional, while the Other One jam is also considered great [7]

## The recordings

- **gd71-12-14.sbd.deibert.12763.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 27 songs; 178 min; rated 4.8/5 by 51 [1]. Said about its sound: Billy's drums are exceptionally clear, with every instrument having incredible presence in the mix [6]
- **gd1971-12-14.sbd.cantor-diebert.23842.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 28 songs; 178 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1971-12-14.sbd.cantor-orf.133.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 169 min; rated 3.44/5 by 9 [4]
- **gd1971-12-14.140950.sbd.betty.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 28 songs; 177 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [2]

## Around the show

- John Sinclair's presence in Ann Arbor contributed to the radical atmosphere during the performance [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd71-12-14.sbd.deibert.12763.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Audio transferred from 7-inch BBD reel to PCM501ES, then Fostex D5, and finally HD [1]
- **gd1971-12-14.sbd.cantor-diebert.23842.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Ken Diebert; source: 7" BBD reel>PCM501ES(beta)>PCM501ES analog out>Fostex D5 @ optical out 48KHz>HD. DAT-1 > Soundforge 4.5 > WAV/SHN mastering by Tim Deibert [3]. Also: Tuning between songs was preserved at track ends, and SBEs were fixed using Shntool [3]
- **gd1971-12-14.sbd.cantor-orf.133.shnf**: transferred by Jeff; source: 7" two track Betty Cantor Reel @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz / PCM501ES analog out > Fostex D5 @ 48 kHz [4]. Also: Noise reduction was applied using Sound Forge 4.5 to remove tape hiss from the recording [4]
- **gd1971-12-14.140950.sbd.betty.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Betty Cantor and Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Betty's 7" 2-track Master Soundboard Reels > PCM > PCM (14 bit)(Sony L-750ESX-HFB tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD >… [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead Hill Auditorium 1971 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-hill-auditorium-1971) [18]
